correctness.rationale: For n>=3, edge incidence B has BB^T=nI-J, so Q=I-B^TB/n projects exactly to ker B. Each edge column has diagonal 1-2/n and 2(n-2) offdiagonal entries of magnitude 1/n, giving ||Q||_{l1 to l1}=3-6/n. Averaging an arbitrary projection by signed edge permutations of S_n does not increase norm; the unique S_n-invariant cycle projection is Q, hence it is optimal. An independent exact rational matrix construction checked every column norm for n=3..10. These computations and symmetrization establish mathematical correctness; no new general lemma is needed once prior Hamming theorem is applied.
residual_risks: Finite verification does not prove all quantified real/dimensional claims; the proof was independently reconstructed and checked against boundary cases.
